text:
mel: Quick UX nit — caught a few small things in Security > Data settings while testing the compliance flow. Can we do a quick sanity pass?

sam: Yep, lay it out.

mel: 1) Key affordance placement — the `Encryption` pill is visually after the region badge so it reads like a region attribute. Feels like users think "region: eu-west-1, encryption: true" instead of "encryption is about key ownership." Suggest moving the pill left of the region badge or making the visual affordance clearly about key ownership (different color + short hint).

mel: 2) Pill copy is ambiguous. Current: `Encrypted` / `BYOK` — but screen readers say "pill" and it's not descriptive. Proposal examples: `Encrypted — Customer-managed key (BYOK)` or `Encrypted — Redwood-managed` for clarity.

anya: +1 on ARIA. Screen reader currently reads: "Encryption pill, button" which is useless. Recommend `aria-label="encryption: customer-managed key, press for key details"` or for managed keys `aria-label="encryption: redwood-managed"`. Also add `role="status"` to the small hint so SR users get the ownership context when the panel opens.

devon: Retention selector related thought — when region fallback happens we show a small badge "Region: fallback" but no explanation. Users keep asking why retention is shorter for some regions. Maybe change badge to `Region: EU (fallback)` and add a tooltip: "Data stored in fallback region due to capacity; retention defaults may differ."

mel: Audit log copy: events use terse verbs like `ENCRYPT` / `KEY_ROTATE` but elsewhere we use sentence-case voice. Inconsistency confuses customers and translators. Suggest normalizing to sentence-case with short context, e.g.:
```
Event: Key rotated by admin@example.com
Details: Customer-managed key rotated (version v3). Action time: 2024-11-02 14:32 UTC
```

sam: Agree — also header formatting: `Event time (UTC)` instead of just `Time` so exported CSVs line up with what users expect.

anya: Small a11y nit: keyboard focus ring on the pills is very faint (1px grey). Need 3:1 contrast border or the system focus token. Also check focus order: if you tab from the route selector you land on a tooltip button before the pill which is surprising.

mel: TL;DR suggestions to ship: move encryption pill left of region badge OR separate visually; adopt copy `Encrypted — Customer-managed key (BYOK)` / `Encrypted — Redwood-managed`; update aria-labels; make focus ring 3:1; clarify audit timestamps column; add tooltip copy for fallback region.

devon: I'll take a tiny design patch and a11y checklist. Will drop sketches in Figma and ping here.

sam: sweet. @anya can you validate SR strings once designs land?

anya: Yep, will run through with NVDA + VoiceOver.

lgtm-bot: Added ticket DM-492 to product backlog (labels: ux-nit, a11y, compliance) :white_check_mark:

mel: Thanks all — small follow-up: can we also update the docs snippet under "Data residency" with the new pill copy so screenshots match?
